items.text: I received this report lawfully, and I may upload it for this review.
I understand this is a document review by software. It is not an inspection, an expert opinion, or legal, insurance or medical advice.
I understand no person reviews my report before it is delivered, and the software can make mistakes.

I have read the Terms of Use and the Privacy and Retention Notice, including that I will not post the marked-up copy or its questions publicly or send them to anyone other than the report's author or my advisers.
